senses.gloss: (Ms. M. גִיהָא) m. (גנה = גנח, or גוה = גוח, v. Nöld. Mand. Gr. p. 52) an abrupt sound, a subterranean thunder, earthquake, rumbling.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:2">Ib.</cite> <he>גנח ג׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>גנא גי׳</he>) a thunder roared (a rumbling was heard).
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ג׳ ג׳ עביד</he> it really comes in one rumbling sound after the other.
